entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's no air or whatever outside of[n]here, right? Does that mean we'd die[n]out there?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Most likely. Regardless, we would never[n]be able to experience this landscape in[n]our normal lives.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: We're still at the beginning of the Palace[n]though. It wouldn't be good if we got[n]thrown off now...
